# guix_key_pair (Resource)

A named management public key for Guix configurations. Pass authorized_key into openssh-service-type authorized-keys and use the matching private key for management. This logical resource does not contact hosts; revocation takes effect when consumers are redeployed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tls_private_key" "management" {
  algorithm = "ED25519"
}

resource "guix_key_pair" "management" {
  name       = "management"
  public_key = tls_private_key.management.public_key_openssh
}

output "management_key" {
  value = {
    public_key  = guix_key_pair.management.authorized_key
    fingerprint = guix_key_pair.management.fingerprint
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Logical key name.
- `public_key` (String) One OpenSSH management public key, such as tls_private_key.management.public_key_openssh.

### Read-Only

- `authorized_key` (String) Canonical OpenSSH public key without comments or authorization options.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA256 OpenSSH public key fingerprint.
- `id` (String) Identity derived from the name and canonical public key.
